prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE finished photorealistic minimalist Earl Grey Matcha Latte catalogue photograph, portrait 3:4, ideally 1086 x 1448.
The provided image is the APPROVED MASTER: preserve its actual product, precise cup shape, branding, typography style and scale, overall layout and product scale. One short broad transparent sundae cup with clear properly seated dome lid. Preserve original girl-and-rabbit 128am Cafe sticker; bunny has exactly TWO ears. At the very bottom show a thin 4–5% liquid-height amber-brown Earl Grey syrup band, beige infused milk above, rich natural green matcha marbling, smooth creamy cold foam gently mounded inside dome with light matcha dusting. Never piped whipped cream or tall foam tower. Preserve realistic plastic refraction, gently improved exposure and appetising true colours.
Packaging must be clean: crystal-clear outer flange and lid rim, dry exterior with no overflow, green smears, external drips or residue; restrained fine condensation acceptable. Full dome, cup and bottom syrup visible with comfortable margins.
Typography exactly as master: large rounded bold Fredoka-style muted rose #B8496C lowercase "earl grey" first line and "matcha latte" second line, smaller "128am Cafe" beneath in the same font. Header centrally aligned at same scale as master with generous top space. Crisp text, no new tracking or font changes. No other text, claims, prices, watermark or badges.
STRICT MINIMALISM: one cup, one plain simple background/surface and a restrained soft shadow. NO props, tea bowls, leaves, flowers, cloth, plants, windows, furniture, objects, decor, patterns, pedestal, other drinks or additional ingredients. Photographic, never illustration/CGI.
Scene: pale blush #FDE5EB seamless studio background merging smoothly into a pale blush matte surface. Photograph this same single cup from a subtle three-quarter side angle, rotated only about 10–15 degrees from front, so the mascot label is still entirely visible and clearly readable. Keep short cup proportions and centred hero scale. Soft bright studio light from left, tidy faint shadow. Typography faces viewer squarely, identical master font, scale and arrangement. Quiet pink catalogue composition with no objects.
